caption: The drawing consists of six vertically aligned sections, each illustrating a different stage, labeled as "Step No. 1" through "Step No. 6," written in small gray text to the right of each section. Each section contains a rectangular grid oriented horizontally, with horizontal and vertical lines forming a matrix of smaller squares. In Step No. 1, the grid is empty, containing no color. In Step No. 2, two patterns of small, filled squares appear within the grid: a vertical column on the left made of alternating orange-red squares, and a ring-shaped formation of orange-red squares arranged to form an empty square or "O" shape on the right. In Step No. 3, a new color is introduced and the pattern becomes more complex; blue squares now fill certain spaces inside and around the existing orange-red squares, beginning to create a more intricate design while the shapes from the previous step are maintained. In Step No. 4, both the blue and orange-red squares are extended further, filling more of the grid area, with the patterns starting to overlap and fill in additional spaces around the initial formations. Step No. 5 shows a further increase in complexity and color density, with both the blue and orange-red squares filling in more of the grid, creating a more intricate and connected pattern. Finally, Step No. 6 displays the entire grid area filled with alternating blue and orange-red squares in an interlocking, repetitive geometric design, covering nearly the entire lower half of the grid, and forming two clear square patterns similar to the one in Step No. 2, but now repeated across the filled grid. The background of the image is a light beige or off-white color with faint lines and markings.
title: Textile: Technique Demonstration
